userId.description: The user whose access is checked; null for the caller.

AccessCheckRequest.description: The body of `access/check`: the access decisions of one user over a list of securables, answered in order.

filter.description: The rows a filtered outcome admits; null for any other outcome.

grants.description: The grants behind the outcome; empty for a denial.

problems.description: The broken permissions that would have reached the securable.

isAllowed.description: Whether the caller may exercise the securable at all: the outcome is not AccessOutcome.Denied.

AccessDecision.description:
What one caller may do with one securable, and why: the outcome, the filter of a filtered
outcome, the grants behind it and the broken permissions that would have reached it.

AccessGrant.description:
One grant behind an access decision: a stored permission of a role
(RoleAccessGrant), a bespoke criterion (BespokeAccessGrant), or
the system short-circuit (SystemAccessGrant).

filter.description: The criterion's filter, rendered as readable text for the "why" answer; never parsed back.

reason.description: The reason key the criterion's provider chose.

AccessGrantBespokeAccessGrant.description: A bespoke criterion that contributed to a filtered decision.

permissionId.description: The id of the stored permission.

roleId.description: The id of the role that holds it.

startsAt.description: When the membership that brings the grant starts; null since always, and for a public role.

endsAt.description: When that membership ends, exclusive; null for no end, and for a public role.

isPublic.description: Whether the role is public, so the grant reaches every user without a membership.

filter.description: The row-level filter; null for an unrestricted grant.

filterQueryexVersion.description: The Queryex version the filter was validated under; null exactly when the filter is.

AccessGrantRoleAccessGrant.description:
One stored permission of an active role that reaches the caller: through a membership, with
its window, or through a public role, which reaches every user.

AccessGrantSystemAccessGrant.description: The system short-circuit: the system set holds every securable, unrestricted.

endsAt.description:
The latest end among the user's current memberships of the roles behind
IReadOnlyList<int> AccessHolder.PermissionIds; null when one of them is permanent.

outcome.description: What the user's own roles allow.

permissionIds.description: The stored permissions behind the outcome, ascending.

AccessHolder.description: One user who holds a securable through the roles they belong to, and until when.

capped.description: Whether more holders the caller may read exist than are listed.

everyone.description: What the public roles and the bespoke criteria allow every user.

grants.description: Every matching stored permission of an active role, with no window.

membersByRole.description: The current members of each role behind the grants and the problems, by role id.

holders.description: The holders the caller may read, by display name.

total.description: Every holder, the ones the caller may not read included.

criteria.description: The bespoke criteria that reach the securable.

problems.description: The stored permissions that would have matched but grant nothing.

related.description: The display projections of the listed users and of the roles behind the grants and the problems.

AccessHolders.description:
Who holds one securable across the tenant, and through what: the public roles and bespoke
criteria that reach every user, each role's grants and current members, and the users whose
own roles allow the securable.

AccessHoldersRequest.description: The body of `access/holders`: who holds one securable, and through which grants.

AccessOutcome.description: What a caller may do with one securable: nothing, the rows a filter admits, or every row.

permissionId.description: The id of the stored permission.

roleId.description: The id of the role that holds it.

diagnostics.description: The engine's diagnostics of an invalid filter; empty for every other code.

AccessProblem.description:
A stored permission that grants nothing, and why. A permission reached through several
memberships is one problem.

AccessProblemCode.description:
Why a stored permission grants nothing. A permission with a problem drifts: it is left out
of the caller's grants and never affects their other permissions, so an administrator whose
one broken permission would otherwise lock them out can still fix it.

tag.description: The caller's composite permissions tag, in its wire form; the same value as the envelope's `permissions` tag.

isSystem.description: Whether the caller is the platform's own system principal, which every securable admits.

securables.description: Every registered securable the caller holds, each once, in the registry's order.

problems.description: The problems found in the caller's roles' permissions, which an administrator fixes.

validUntil.description:
When the summary next changes on its own: the next start or end of one of the caller's
membership windows; null when none lies ahead.

AccessSummary.description: What the caller may do, as the `me` envelope carries it.

AffectedResult.description: The answer of a delete, and of an operation that reports only how many rows it affected.

include.description: The details extras to include, by name; an unknown name is a bad-request error. Null or empty for none.

AllRequest.description: The body of a cacheable stack's `all`: every row in details shape, served from the cache.

filter.description: The criterion's filter, rendered as readable text for the "why" answer; never parsed back.

reason.description: The reason key the criterion's provider chose.

BespokeAccessGrant.description: A bespoke criterion that contributed to a filtered decision.

ClientSyncRequest.description:
The body of `client/sync`: the version tags a browser tab holds for one tenant's cached
documents, each in its wire form, so the answer carries only what changed.

tags.description:
The current wire tags by name: always `settings`, `preferences`,
`permissions` and `entities`, plus one `entity:<Name>` per cacheable
entity when the held `entities` tag differs or is absent.

oneOf.description:
The tenant's settings as the client sees them, written from the bytes the settings cache
serialized when it loaded them; null when the held `settings` tag is current.

The caller's own envelope, as `users/me` answers it; null when the held
`preferences` and `permissions` tags are both current.

staleEntities.description: The cacheable entities whose held `entity:<Name>` tag differs, in name order.

ClientSyncResult.description:
The answer of `client/sync`: the tenant's facts and current tags, and only the cached
documents whose held tags differ.

ConcurrencyMode.description:
Whether a save compares each updated row's stamp with the one the client read. Defined once,
here, for every layer that saves.

keys.description: The warning keys confirmed: one to sixteen, each of at most a hundred characters, covering every key each target waits on.

ConfirmJobArguments.description: The arguments of the jobs' `confirm` action.

id.description: The service account's user id.

clientId.description: The client id the account authenticates with.

CredentialsResult.description:
The answer of the users' `issue-credentials` action: the service account's new client
id and its secret, which crosses the wire once, in this answer, and is stored nowhere.

createdAt.description: When the row was created; server-owned, `datetimeoffset(7)`.

createdById.description: The user who created the row; server-owned, a foreign key to `core.Users`.

modifiedAt.description:
When the row was last changed by a user-visible mutation; server-owned,
`datetimeoffset(7)`, and the row's concurrency token.

modifiedById.description: The user who last changed the row; server-owned, a foreign key to `core.Users`.

id.description:
The primary key. Server-owned: the allocator assigns it to a new row, and a client value
on an existing row only addresses that row.

filter.description: The Queryex filter selecting the rows; never blank.

arguments.description: The values of the filter's parameters, as JSON scalars keyed by parameter name.

expectedCount.description: The number of rows the caller was shown and expects to delete.

DeleteByQueryRequest.description:
The body of a stack's `delete-by-query`: delete every visible row a filter matches,
provided there are exactly as many as the caller was shown. Web surface only; never an
agent tool.

collection.description: The collection's property name on its owner (`RoleMemberships`).

columns.description: The collection's editable column paths to restrict its sheet to; null for all.

referenceKeys.description: Per foreign-key property of the collection's entity, the target property to express it in; null for the defaults.

children.description: The collections one level down that get a sheet: null for all, empty for none.

ExportCollection.description:
One child collection an editable-shape export writes a sheet for: a collection of the parent,
or of an enclosing collection, with its members following the request's rules for the
collection's own entity.

expression.description: The column's key as the grid holds it: a path (`Customer.Code`) or a query expression (`Total * 2`).

header.description: The header text, at most int ExportColumn.MaxHeaderLength characters; null derives it from the labels.

ExportColumn.description: One column of a display-shape export, as the grid shows it.

columns.description:
The parent's editable column paths to restrict the sheet to; null for all. `Id`,
`Stamp` and the default natural key's column are always kept; a path that is not
editable is a bad request.

referenceKeys.description:
Per foreign-key property, the target property to express it in (`CenterId` →
`Code`), overriding the target's default natural key; any scalar property of the
target is allowed.

children.description:
The child collections that get a sheet: null for every collection at every depth, empty
for none, else that subset. A collection left out has no sheet, so importing the file
back leaves it untouched.

ids.description: The rows by id, or null to select by the clauses; at most the stack's id limit.

filters.description: Query predicates, each compiled as its own leaf, conjoined; null or empty for none.

namedFilters.description: The stack's named filters to apply, by name, conjoined; null or empty for none.

orderBy.description: The ordering, as query ordering text; null orders by id.

search.description: The search text, carried unchanged; null for none.

arguments.description: The values of the clauses' parameters, as JSON scalars keyed by parameter name; null for none.

includeInactive.description:
On an activatable stack: whether inactive rows are included. False by default, so an
export by the clauses carries the rows the grid shows.

ExportForImportRequest.description:
The body of an editable-shape `export-for-import`: the rows, chosen as
ExportSourceRequest chooses them, and which columns, reference keys and child
collections the workbook carries.

columns.description: The columns, one sheet column each, in order; from 1 to int ExportRequest.MaxColumns.

ids.description: The rows by id, or null to select by the clauses; at most the stack's id limit.

filters.description: Query predicates, each compiled as its own leaf, conjoined; null or empty for none.

namedFilters.description: The stack's named filters to apply, by name, conjoined; null or empty for none.

orderBy.description: The ordering, as query ordering text; null orders by id.

search.description: The search text, carried unchanged; null for none.

arguments.description: The values of the clauses' parameters, as JSON scalars keyed by parameter name; null for none.

includeInactive.description:
On an activatable stack: whether inactive rows are included. False by default, so an
export by the clauses carries the rows the grid shows.

ExportRequest.description:
The body of a display-shape `export`: the rows, chosen as ExportSourceRequest
chooses them, and the columns the grid shows, in order.

FilterTree.description: A predicate composed structurally from independent expression leaves.

include.description: The details extras to include, by name; an unknown name is a bad-request error. Null or empty for none.

GetByIdsRequest.description:
The body of a stack's `get-by-ids`: rows in details shape, in the requested order. The
answer is partial: an absent or hidden id is omitted, never a not-found error.

id.description: The row's id; a number or a string on the wire, narrowed to the stack's key type.

include.description: The details extras to include, by name; an unknown name is a bad-request error. Null or empty for none.

GetRequest.description:
The body of a stack's `get`: one row in details shape. A row that is absent or hidden
by row-level security is a not-found error, identical in both cases.

IdentityDeliveryState.description: How far the latest invitation the distribution raised for a subject got.

expectsDeliveryEvents.description:
Whether a provider will report further on the message. False makes
IdentityDeliveryState.Sent the end of the story: a relay that reports nothing
back leaves no feedback, which never means that delivery failed.

sentUtc.description: When the message reached a transport; null until it has.

updatedUtc.description: When a provider last reported on it; null when none has.

reason.description:
The provider's failure detail, present only for IdentityDeliveryState.Bounced,
IdentityDeliveryState.Rejected, IdentityDeliveryState.Abandoned
and IdentityDeliveryState.Complained.

IdentityDeliveryStatus.description: The delivery state of the latest invitation the distribution raised for one subject.

id.description: The row's id; a number or a string on the wire, narrowed to the stack's key type.

IdRequest.description: The body of a single-target entity action, which names exactly one row and answers a result of its own.

id.description: The row's id; a number or a string on the wire, narrowed to the stack's key type.

IdRequestOfNotificationPreferencesArgume.description: The body of a single-target entity action that takes arguments.

id.description: The row's id; a number or a string on the wire, narrowed to the stack's key type.

IdRequestOfUserPreferenceKeysArguments.description: The body of a single-target entity action that takes arguments.

id.description: The row's id; a number or a string on the wire, narrowed to the stack's key type.

IdRequestOfUserPreferencesArguments.description: The body of a single-target entity action that takes arguments.

IdsRequest.description:
A body that names rows by id: `delete`, `delete-with-descendants`, an entity
action with a result of its own that targets many rows, and an operation whose body is ids
alone.

sheet.description: The sheet's name, as the workbook spells it.

column.description: The column's letters (`A` to `XFD`, either case), as the import plan reports them.

path.description: The column path to map the column to (`Name`, `Parent.Code`); null ignores the column.

ImportColumnMapping.description:
A caller's mapping of one workbook column, which wins over the manifest and the headers. A
column is addressed by its letters, never by its header text, which may repeat, be blank or
look like a path.

ImportColumnStatus.description: What an import plan made of one column of a sheet.

sheet.description: The sheet's name; null when the failure has no place in the workbook.

row.description: The Excel row, 1-based; null when the failure concerns no row.

column.description: The column's letters (`C`); null when the failure concerns no column.

header.description: The column's header text; null when the failure concerns no column.

property.description: The CLR name of the property the value maps to; null when the failure ends at a row or concerns the whole file.

ImportError.description:
One import failure or warning at the workbook cell it concerns: a codec error, or a
pipeline validation error mapped from its path to the cell that produced the value.

ImportMode.description: What an import does with each parent row of the workbook.

stopped.description: Whether a requested stop ended a background import between chunks, the counts covering the chunks that committed.

ImportOutcome.description:
What an import committed: the parent and child counts, the runs of workbook rows it
committed, and its warnings. A background import's counts cover every attempt.

entity.description: The entity the workbook's manifest names; null when the workbook carries no manifest.

manifestPresent.description: Whether the workbook carries a readable manifest.

sameSource.description: Whether the workbook was exported by the same deployment and tenant, so its ids may key rows.

schemaFingerprintMatches.description: Whether the manifest's schema fingerprint is the entity's current one.

defaultRowKey.description: The row key an import takes when the request names none; null when none resolves.

requiresBackground.description: Whether the file is above a synchronous limit, so only a background import can run it.

atomicAllowed.description: Whether the file is within the limits of an import that commits in one transaction.

ImportPlan.description:
How an import would read a workbook, worked out before any row is decoded beyond the header
rows: what each sheet and column binds to, the row keys on offer and the paths that can run
the file.

path.description:
The resolved column path: a multilingual column's slot in the target tenant, a reference's
key. Null when the column maps to nothing.

status.description: What the plan made of the column.

language.description: The language of a multilingual column, a BCP 47 code; null otherwise.

ImportPlanColumn.description:
What an import plan made of one column: its header, the path it maps to and why. Echoing
the column back as an ImportColumnMapping keeps its meaning.

collection.description:
The collection path the sheet holds: an empty string for the parent rows, null when the
sheet holds nothing the import reads.

status.description: What the plan made of the sheet.

ImportPlanSheet.description: What an import plan made of one sheet: what it holds, how many rows, and each column.

fileId.description: The id of the caller's own staged upload of kind `import-file`; required.

mode.description: What the import does with each parent row; ImportMode.Insert by default.

rowKey.description:
The column that identifies a parent row in ImportMode.Update and
ImportMode.Upsert: a natural key's path, or `Id`, which only a file
exported from the same deployment and tenant accepts. Null takes the default: `Id`
on such a file, else the entity's natural key.

sheetMappings.description: The caller's sheet mappings, at most one per sheet; empty for none.

columnMappings.description: The caller's column mappings, at most one per sheet and column; empty for none.

ignoreUnmappedColumns.description: Whether a column the mapping cannot place is ignored; false by default, which makes it an error.

ignoreSheetStamps.description:
Whether the sheet's stamps are ignored, so the stamp read when each row is loaded is its
expected stamp; false by default, which makes a row edited since the export a conflict.

ImportRequest.description:
The body of `import`: an uploaded workbook, what to do with its rows, and the caller's
overrides of the mapping.

sheet.description: The sheet's name, as the workbook spells it.

collection.description:
What the sheet holds: an empty string for the parent rows, a collection path
(`RoleMemberships`, `WidgetParts.WidgetPartNotes`) for that collection's rows, or
null to ignore the sheet.

ImportSheetMapping.description: A caller's mapping of one workbook sheet, which wins over the manifest and the sheet names.

ImportSheetStatus.description: What an import plan made of one sheet of the workbook.

id.description: The job's id.

handlerKey.description: The key of the job's handler.

progressPercent.description: The progress in percent; `null` when the handler reported none.

progressKey.description: The resource key of the progress message; `null` for none.

progressArgumentsJson.description: The progress message's arguments as a JSON object; `null` for none.

cancelRequestedAt.description: When a stop was requested; `null` when none was.

startedAt.description: When the job first started running; `null` while it has not.

labelKey.description: The resource key of the job's own label; `null` for the handler's label.

labelArgumentsJson.description: The label's arguments as a JSON object; `null` for none.

InboxRunningJob.description:
One of the calling user's own jobs that has not ended, as the bell lists it: pending,
running, held or waiting for a confirmation, and requested by the user rather than fired by
a schedule.

unseen.description:
How many rows arrived after the user last opened the bell, up to
int NotificationsOptions.SummaryCountCap.

oneOf.description:
The most severe of those unseen rows, the newest ones within the cap; `null`
when none is unseen.

unread.description: How many rows are unread, up to int NotificationsOptions.SummaryCountCap.

latest.description:
The newest rows, read or not, at most int NotificationsOptions.SummaryLatestCount,
newest first.

running.description:
The caller's own jobs that have not ended, cron occurrences aside, at most
int NotificationsOptions.SummaryLatestCount, newest first.

related.description: The users who acted in IReadOnlyList<Notification> InboxSummary.Latest, as their related projection shows them.

version.description: The caller's inbox version, which every inbox verb increments.

seenAt.description: When the caller last opened the bell; `null` when never.

InboxSummary.description:
What the bell shows for the calling user: the capped unseen and unread counts, the most
severe unseen row, the newest rows, the caller's own jobs still running, the users who
acted in the newest rows, and the inbox's version.

count.description:
The rows the verb changed: 1 for marking the inbox seen, the rows newly marked read, or the
rows deleted.

version.description: The caller's inbox version after the verb.

InboxVerbResult.description: What an inbox verb did: the rows it changed and the inbox's version after it.

fileId.description: The id of the caller's own staged upload of kind `import-file`; required.

sheetMappings.description: The caller's sheet mappings, at most one per sheet; empty for none.

columnMappings.description: The caller's column mappings, at most one per sheet and column; empty for none.

InspectImportRequest.description:
The body of `inspect-import`: an uploaded workbook and the caller's overrides, which
the server maps into an import plan without importing anything.

id.description: The user's id.

state.description: How far the user has come.

oneOf.description: The identity server's answer to the user's last successful invitation; null when none succeeded.

lastInviteError.description: Why the user's last invitation failed; null when it succeeded or none was made.

oneOf.description: The invitation email's delivery; null when no email is expected.

InvitationStatus.description:
A user's invitation as the users' `invitation-status` operation reports it: the stored
state and outcome, and the delivery of the invitation email where one was raised.

id.description: The user's id.

oneOf.description: The identity server's answer; null when the user was not invited.

error.description: Why the user was not invited; null when the user was.

InviteResult.description:
One user's outcome of the users' `invite` action, answered in request order: the
identity server's status, or why the user was not invited.

resourceId.description:
The row the job works on when one exists already, such as an import's row; null for an
export, whose row the job inserts when it completes, and for a schedule's immediate run.

JobAccepted.description:
The answer of an operation that hands its work to a background job: the job to follow. The
web edge answers it with 202 and carries the polling target in the body, not in a
`Location` header.

JobStatus.description:
Where a job is in its life, stored as the member's name, `varchar(19)`. A job is queued
JobStatus.Pending, leased JobStatus.Running by a claim, and ends
JobStatus.Succeeded, JobStatus.Failed or JobStatus.Cancelled; a stale queued
job waits JobStatus.Held for an administrator after a service interruption, and a job
that raised a warning waits JobStatus.PendingConfirmation for its initiator.

key.description: The key, such as `nav.pinned`: dotted segments, the first led by a lower-case letter.

value.description: The value, opaque to the server; typically JSON the client wrote.

KeyValueItem.description: One preference of a user's preference bag: a dotted key and its value.

code.description: The bare BCP 47 language subtag (`ar`), never a region pair; compared without regard to case.

nativeName.description: The language's name in itself (`العربية`), the same in every interface language.

symbol.description:
The short mark in the language's own script that labels its column of a multilingual
field: `E` for English, `ع` for Arabic, as in `Name (ع)`.

isRightToLeft.description: Whether the language is written right to left.

LanguageInfo.description: A language the platform can describe: one entry of the language catalogue.

language.description: The preferred language, a bare language code the distribution offers; null to leave it.

calendar.description: The preferred calendar; null to leave it.

timeZone.description: The preferred time zone, an IANA zone the platform knows; null to leave it.

region.description: The preferred region, which the regional formats follow; null to leave it.

oneOf.description: The preferred digits; null to leave them.

reset.description: The members to return to the tenant's default; null or empty for none.

MeLocaleRequest.description:
A change of the caller's own locale: each member set is stored, each member named in
Reset returns to the tenant's default, and a null member is left as
stored. A request sets or resets at least one member, and never both for one member.

preferredLanguage.description: The stored preferred language; null for the tenant's default.

preferredCalendar.description: The stored preferred calendar; null for the tenant's default.

preferredTimeZone.description: The stored preferred time zone; null for the tenant's default.

preferredRegion.description: The stored preferred region; null for the language's default.

oneOf.description: The stored preferred digits; null for the language's default.

modifiedAt.description: The row's stamp after the change.

preferencesTag.description: The caller's preferences tag after the change, in its wire form.

MeLocaleResult.description:
The caller's locale members as stored after a locale change, the row's stamp, and the
caller's preferences tag as it travels in the version-tags header, so the calling tab adopts
them at once.

preferencesTag.description: The caller's preferences tag, in its wire form; the same value as the `preferences` item of Tags.

preferences.description: The caller's preference bag: every key it holds, with its value.

tags.description:
The client tags by item name (`settings`, `permissions`, `preferences`,
`entities`), each in its wire form, exactly as the version-tags header carries them.

MeResult.description:
The `me` envelope: the caller's profile, preference bag and access summary, with the
four client tags as the version-tags header carries them, so a client caches all of it
under the tags it was read with.

name.description: The name in the tenant's first content language.

name2.description: The name in the second content language; null for none.

name3.description: The name in the third content language; null for none.

imageId.description: The profile picture's blob; null for none.

signatureId.description: The signature's blob; null for none.

oneOf.description: The gender; null when not stated.

contactEmail.description: The address notifications go to instead of the sign-in email; null for the sign-in email.

contactMobile.description: The mobile number, in international format; null for none.

modifiedAt.description: The row's stamp as the caller last read it.

concurrency.description:
ConcurrencyMode.Check to refuse the edit when the row changed since
            ModifiedAt; ConcurrencyMode.Override once the caller chose
            to overwrite that change.

MeSaveRequest.description:
The caller's own profile as the caller edits it: the eight members a member may change on
their own row, the stamp the edit was made against, and how a stamp that moved since is
treated. The locale members change through a request of their own.

MissedPolicy.description:
What a schedule does with the occurrences it missed while nothing ticked: a stopped worker,
a read-only tenant or an outage. Stored as the member's name, `varchar(9)`.

activeSubtreeCount.description:
The number of active rows in the subtree rooted at this row, the row itself included when
it is active; server-owned, recounted by the data layer after every write.

parentId.description: The parent row, or `null` for a root; a foreign key to the same table.

subtreeCount.description:
The number of rows in the subtree rooted at this row, the row itself included, so 1 for a
leaf; server-owned, recounted by the data layer after every write.

createdAt.description: When the row was created; server-owned, `datetimeoffset(7)`.

createdById.description: The user who created the row; server-owned, a foreign key to `core.Users`.

modifiedAt.description:
When the row was last changed by a user-visible mutation; server-owned,
`datetimeoffset(7)`, and the row's concurrency token.

modifiedById.description: The user who last changed the row; server-owned, a foreign key to `core.Users`.

id.description:
The primary key. Server-owned: the allocator assigns it to a new row, and a client value
on an existing row only addresses that row.

type.description: The key of the notification's registered type, `nvarchar(64)`.

severity.description: The row's severity: the raising request's, else its type's.

argumentsJson.description:
The message's arguments as a JSON object, `nvarchar(4000)`; null for none. Also the
data the client acts on when the row is opened.

targetResource.description: The securable resource the notification points at, `varchar(128)`, such as `core.Export`; null for none.

targetId.description: The id of the row the notification points at; null when it points at none.

actorUserId.description: The user whose action caused the notification; null when the system caused it.

dedupKey.description:
The key that collapses repeated notifications of one subject for one recipient,
`nvarchar(128)`; null for a notification that never collapses.

createdAt.description: When the notification was raised, or last refreshed in place, `datetimeoffset(3)`.

readAt.description: When the recipient read it, `datetimeoffset(3)`; null while unread.

id.description:
The primary key. Server-owned: the allocator assigns it to a new row, and a client value
on an existing row only addresses that row.

Notification.description:
A row of `core.Notifications`: one notification in one user's inbox. System-written:
only INotifier, the inbox's own verbs and retention write it, never a save,
and its stack serves reads alone.

type.description: The key of a registered notification type.

channel.description: The key of a registered notification channel.

enabled.description: Whether the channel delivers the type to the user.

NotificationPreference.description:
One of a user's notification preferences: whether a channel delivers a type to them. A row
shape, not an entity.

preferences.description: The user's complete set, each type and channel once.

NotificationPreferencesArguments.description:
The arguments of an administrator's save of another user's notification preferences: that
user's complete set, as the user's own save takes it. A type and channel absent from the
set revert to the channel's default.

OverlapPolicy.description:
Whether a schedule fires while a job it fired earlier has not ended. Stored as the member's
name, `varchar(8)`.

parentIds.description: The parents' ids; null or empty for the roots. Numbers or strings on the wire, narrowed to the stack's key type.

select.description: The Queryex select; null for the stack's default select.

filters.description: Queryex predicates, each its own leaf, conjoined; null or empty for none.

arguments.description: The values of the clauses' parameters, as JSON scalars keyed by parameter name.

includeInactive.description: On an activatable tree: whether inactive rows are included.

includeRoots.description: With parent ids: whether the roots come too, in the same row set and the same statement.

orderBy.description: The Queryex ordering; null for the stack's default ordering, else `Id`.

namedFilters.description: The stack's named filters to apply, by name, conjoined; an unknown name is a query-invalid error.

ParentIdsRequest.description:
The body of a tree stack's `get-by-parent-ids`: the children of the given parents, and
the roots on request, as one row set with no count and no ancestors.

resource.description: The resource granted, or the wildcard, `varchar(128)`.

action.description: The action granted, or the wildcard, `varchar(32)`.

filter.description:
A query-language predicate over the securable's filter root that narrows the grant to the
rows it matches, `nvarchar(2048)`; null grants every row.

filterQueryexVersion.description:
The query-language version string? Permission.Filter was validated under; derived, stamped by
the role save and null exactly when string? Permission.Filter is.

notes.description: Why the permission exists, for an access review, `nvarchar(1024)`.

id.description:
The primary key. Server-owned: the allocator assigns it to a new row, and a client value
on an existing row only addresses that row.

Permission.description:
One grant of a role: an action on a resource, optionally narrowed by a filter. Saved with its
role. The platform's default: a distribution extends it by inheritance and registers its class
as the leaf.

preferences.description: Every key the bag holds, with its value.

preferencesTag.description: The caller's preferences tag after the write, in its wire form.

PreferencesResult.description:
The caller's own preference bag after a write, with the caller's preferences tag as it
travels in the version-tags header, so the calling tab adopts both at once.

PreSerializedJsonOfTenantSettingsForClie.description:
A value of T already serialized as UTF-8 JSON under the platform's
rules, which a result member writes as those bytes, unchanged: serving a document the
platform serialized once and caches never serializes it again.

set.description: The role grants to add, or whose access to change; null for none.

remove.description: The roles whose grants to remove; null for none.

everyone.description: True adds the Everyone grant, at view access; false removes it; null leaves it as it is.

PublishArguments.description:
The arguments of the `publish` action: role grants and the Everyone grant merged into
each target's grants. Grants the arguments do not name are kept.

clause.description:
The request clause the diagnostic concerns, a closed list: `select`,
`filters[i]`, `namedFilters[i]`, `orderBy`, `having` and
`measures`.

code.description:
The diagnostic code: a compiler code such as `QX3001`, one of the pipeline's
`Query.*` validation codes, or, for a permission filter checked as a role save checks
it, the role save's `Permissions.FilterTooLong` and `Permissions.FilterInvalid`.

start.description: The zero-based offset of the offending range within the clause's text.

length.description: The length of the offending range; may be zero.

location.description: Which item of the clause the range indexes into, such as `Select[2]`; null when the clause is a single expression.

arguments.description:
The named values the diagnostic's message renders from. They derive from the caller's own
input and are untrusted display data.

QueryDiagnostic.description:
One query diagnostic as the wire carries it to an editor: the compiler's code, position and
arguments verbatim, plus the request clause it concerns. A query-invalid problem carries
one per diagnostic, and query discovery answers them for text being typed.

filter.description: The index of the filter in the request.

path.description: The compared path, dotted (`Invoice.CustomerId`); null when an expression is compared.

expression.description: The compared expression's canonical text; null when a path is compared.

oneOf.description: The literal in the wire's scalar encoding; null for a null literal.

type.description: The type of the compared path or expression.

QueryexConjunct.description:
One top-level `and` atom of a filter that compares a path or an expression with a
literal, which an editor can render as a chip.

code.description: The stable diagnostic code, such as "QX3001".

span.description: The offending range within the text named by Location.

location.description:
Which input the span indexes into: a clause and item such as "Select[2]" or "OrderBy[0]",
a filter-tree path such as "Filter.Or[1]", or null when a single expression list was
validated on its own.

arguments.description:
Named values for message composition, such as the offending property name or the entity
it was looked for on. Values are derived from the caller's own input and must be treated
as untrusted display data.

root.description: The entity the clauses are read from, such as `gl.Center`.

select.description: The Queryex select; null for none.

filters.description: Queryex predicates, each its own leaf, conjoined as a query conjoins them; null or empty for none.

having.description: The group-level predicate of an aggregate query; null for none.

orderBy.description: The Queryex ordering; null for none.

measures.description: The measures of a pivot or a summary, as a comma-separated list; null for none, and refused without an aggregate.

aggregate.description: Whether the select is an aggregation.

parameters.description: The parameter types the author confirmed; every other parameter's type is inferred.

profile.description: Whether the text is checked as a query or as a permission filter.

conjuncts.description: Whether the answer also carries each filter's top-level comparisons of a path or an expression with a literal.

QueryexDiscoverRequest.description:
The body of `queryex/discover`: the clauses of a query, or one permission filter, being
written in an editor, checked as the query or the role save would compile them, with no
SQL run.

diagnostics.description: The problems a query, or a role save, would refuse the text for; empty when it would compile.

conjuncts.description: The filters' top-level comparisons with a literal; null unless asked for.

QueryexDiscoverResult.description:
What `queryex/discover` found in the text it was sent: every problem, every parameter
with its type, every path with whether the caller may read through it, and on request the
filters' top-level comparisons. A problem never fails the call.

name.description: The parameter's name as written, without its `@`.

oneOf.description: The confirmed type, else the inferred one; null when nothing constrains the parameter or its uses conflict.

conflicts.description: The incompatible types its uses demand; empty when they agree.

comparedWith.description: The segments of the one path the parameter is compared with, from the root; null when it meets none, or several.

entity.description: The entity a key or foreign key at the end of that path identifies; null otherwise.

QueryexParameterInfo.description: One parameter the clauses mention, with the type it takes.

name.description: The parameter's name, without its `@`; matched without regard to case.

type.description: The confirmed type; neither a hierarchy nor a geography, which have no parameter form.

QueryexParameterInput.description: A parameter type the author confirmed, which wins over the type the clauses imply.

segments.description: The path's segments, from the root.

entity.description: The entity the last segment is read on.

reachable.description: Whether the caller may read through the path; false when a query would refuse it.

clause.description: The request clause, as a query diagnostic names it: `select`, `filters[i]`, `orderBy` or `having`.

location.description: Which item of the clause the range indexes into, such as `Select[2]`; null when the clause is a single expression.

start.description: The zero-based offset of the range within the clause's text.

length.description: The length of the range; may be zero.

QueryexSite.description: Where something is written in the request's clauses, located as a query diagnostic is.

start.description: The zero-based index of the first character.

length.description: The number of characters covered. May be zero.

end.description: The index one past the last character covered.

QueryexSpan.description: A half-open character range within the text of one expression.

select.description: The Queryex select; null for the stack's default select.

filters.description:
Queryex predicates, each compiled as its own leaf so a diagnostic points at the one that
failed, conjoined; null or empty for none.

namedFilters.description:
The stack's named filters to apply, by name, conjoined; an unknown name is a
query-invalid error. Null or empty for none.

having.description: The Queryex having clause; with bool QueryRequest.Aggregate only.

orderBy.description: The Queryex ordering; null for the stack's default ordering, else `Id desc`.

skip.description: The rows to skip; 0 by default.

search.description: The search text, carried unchanged; at most the stack's search length.

arguments.description:
The values of the clauses' parameters, as JSON scalars keyed by parameter name. Their
types are inferred from the clauses; a value that does not convert is a bad-request
error naming the parameter, a parameter without a value binds null, and a value no
clause mentions is ignored.

includeCount.description: Whether the response carries the capped grand-total count, computed in the same round trip.

includeAncestors.description: On a tree stack: whether the response carries the ancestors of the page's matches that are not in the page.

includeInactive.description: On an activatable stack: whether inactive rows are included, lifting the active-only conjunct.

aggregate.description: Whether the select is an aggregation, grouped by its non-aggregated items.

QueryRequest.description:
The body of a stack's or a child query surface's `query`: Queryex clauses, paging and
the options of the one round trip that answers it with a page of columnar rows.

RelatedEntities.description:
The related entities a read carries beside its main entities, one typed set per entity name, each
restricted to that entity's related projection. Serialised as entity name to array.

code.description: The natural key seeds find the report by, `nvarchar(50)`, unique when present; a feature's prefix is reserved to its seeds.

title.description: The title in the tenant's primary language, `nvarchar(255)`; a save that leaves it empty takes the default title.

title2.description: The title in the tenant's secondary language.

title3.description: The title in the tenant's tertiary language.

description.description: The description in the tenant's primary language, `nvarchar(1024)`.

description2.description: The description in the tenant's secondary language.

root.description: The entity the report reads, by its name, such as `acme.SalesInvoiceLine`; `varchar(128)`.

kind.description: The report's kind, which names the one block its document holds.

definitionJson.description: The definition document, camelCase JSON read into ReportDocument.

queryexVersion.description: The query language version the document's expressions are read under; derived by the service.

ownerId.description: The user who owns the report; stamped by the service on insert, kept by every update, changed only by a transfer; null for a standard report.

basedOnId.description: The report a "save as" copied, set on insert only; lineage, with no foreign key, since the source may be deleted later.

roleId.description: The id of the role that holds it.

filterQueryexVersion.description: The Queryex version the filter was validated under; null exactly when the filter is.

access.description: What the grant lets the role's members do.

occurrences; greater than zero.

action; the system user on a built-in.

Schedule.description:

time it comes due. An ordinary editable entity; the scheduler's own bookkeeping lives in a
separate table, so a tick never writes this row or its history.

SecurableRef.description:
A securable named by its pair alone: the resource and the action a permission targets,
written `resource:action` in logs, diagnostics and the role editor.

hasFilter.description: Whether the caller's grant is narrowed by a row-level filter rather than unrestricted.

SecurableSummary.description:
One securable the caller holds, as the `me` envelope's access summary lists it: the
pair, and whether a row-level filter narrows it.

tenantId.description:
The tenant the database belongs to: a routing guard compared with the routed tenant on
every load, never a filter. Zero marks the unprovisioned placeholder.

name.description: The tenant's display name in its primary language, `nvarchar(255)`.

name2.description: The tenant's display name in its secondary language.

name3.description: The tenant's display name in its tertiary language.

primaryLanguage.description: The primary content language, a code the distribution offers, `varchar(35)`.

secondaryLanguage.description: The secondary content language, distinct from the primary; null for none.

tertiaryLanguage.description: The tertiary content language, which requires a secondary one and differs from both; null for none.

primaryCalendar.description: The primary calendar, a code of the calendar registry, `varchar(16)`.

secondaryCalendar.description: The secondary calendar, distinct from the primary; null for none.

timeZone.description:
The tenant's zone, an IANA id, `varchar(64)`: the zone the tenant's business date is
computed in.

region.description:
The tenant's default region, an upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, `varchar(2)`,
below each user's own preference; null for each language's default region.

oneOf.description: The tenant's default digits, below each user's own preference; null for the region's default.

createdAt.description: When the row was created; server-owned, `datetimeoffset(7)`.

createdById.description: The user who created the row; server-owned, a foreign key to `core.Users`.

modifiedAt.description:
When the row was last changed by a user-visible mutation; server-owned,
`datetimeoffset(7)`, and the row's concurrency token.

modifiedById.description: The user who last changed the row; server-owned, a foreign key to `core.Users`.

id.description:
The primary key. Server-owned: the allocator assigns it to a new row, and a client value
on an existing row only addresses that row.

Settings.description:
The tenant's typed settings: the single row of the settings the platform itself reads to
build every request's context (the routing guard, the display name, the content
languages, the calendars, the zone and the default formats).

details.description:
The editor's view of every category the caller may read, with a stamp for every stored row,
listed in the save or not.

client.description: The client's view, as every member now reads it.

settingsTag.description: The client view's new wire tag, which the response's version-tags header carries too.

SettingsSaveResult.description: What a settings save answers: the editor's view and the client's, as committed, so neither reloads.

ShareAccess.description: What a grant of a shareable row lets its grantee do. Stored by name.

set.description: The user grants to add, or whose access to change; null for none.

remove.description: The users whose grants to remove; null for none.

ShareArguments.description:
The arguments of the `share` action: user grants merged into each target's grants.
Grants the arguments do not name are kept.

atomic.description:
Whether the whole file commits in one transaction rather than in chunks; false by
default. A file above the atomic limits fails the job before anything is written.

fileId.description: The id of the caller's own staged upload of kind `import-file`; required.

mode.description: What the import does with each parent row; ImportMode.Insert by default.

rowKey.description:
The column that identifies a parent row in ImportMode.Update and
ImportMode.Upsert: a natural key's path, or `Id`, which only a file
exported from the same deployment and tenant accepts. Null takes the default: `Id`
on such a file, else the entity's natural key.

sheetMappings.description: The caller's sheet mappings, at most one per sheet; empty for none.

columnMappings.description: The caller's column mappings, at most one per sheet and column; empty for none.

ignoreUnmappedColumns.description: Whether a column the mapping cannot place is ignored; false by default, which makes it an error.

ignoreSheetStamps.description:
Whether the sheet's stamps are ignored, so the stamp read when each row is loaded is its
expected stamp; false by default, which makes a row edited since the export a conflict.

StartImportRequest.description: The body of `import/start`: an import that runs in the background.

TenantCategory.description:
Whether a tenant is a business's live books or a sandbox. Fixed when the tenant is
registered and never changed afterwards.

id.description: The tenant's id.

category.description: Whether the tenant holds live books or is a sandbox.

liveTenantId.description: A sandbox's live tenant; null for a live tenant.

realtime.description: Whether this host serves the real-time hub, so the client connects instead of polling.

TenantFacts.description:
What a browser tab needs to know about the tenant it shows: its kind, its lifecycle state
and whether the host serves the real-time hub, as `client/sync` reports them.

oneOf.description:
The typed row with its audit columns, when the caller may read the general settings; null
otherwise. Its `ModifiedAt` is the stamp a save of a typed member expects back.

values.description:
The current value of every non-secret key of the categories the caller may read, by key:
the stored value, else the key's default.

setKeys.description: The keys of those categories a row is stored for, secrets included.

entryStamps.description:
The modification stamp of each stored row of those categories, by key: what a save of that
entry expects back.

related.description:
The display projection of every entity a reference key's value points at, as the cached
settings held the ids; an id whose row no longer exists is absent.

TenantSettingsDetails.description:
The settings editor's view of the tenant's settings: only the categories the caller may
read, each value with the stamp a save expects back for it.

names.description: The tenant's display name in each content language, by position 1 to 3; null where unset.

timeZone.description: The tenant's zone, an IANA id.

region.description: The tenant's default region; null for each language's default.

oneOf.description: The tenant's default digits; null for the region's default.

entries.description: Every client-visible setting by key, stored or default: the client never learns which.

TenantSettingsForClient.description:
Everything any member of the tenant may know about its settings: the client's view. It is
cached beside the tenant's settings as UTF-8 JSON serialized once per load, so serving it
never serializes.

fields.description:
The members set: typed members by name (`Name2`, `PrimaryLanguage`), and entries
as `entries.` followed by the key (`entries.gl.posting.autoNumberOnPost`).

name.description: The tenant's name in its primary language.

name2.description: The tenant's name in its secondary language.

name3.description: The tenant's name in its tertiary language.

timeZone.description: The tenant's zone, an IANA id.

entries.description: The listed entries' values, by key; null when no entry is listed.

expectedModifiedAt.description: The typed row's stamp as read, required under `Check` when a typed member is listed.

expectedEntryStamps.description:
Each listed entry's stamp as read, by key: the row's stamp, or null when no row was read.
Under `Check` every listed entry needs one.

concurrency.description: Whether the stamps are compared; `Override` skips every comparison.

TenantSettingsPatch.description:
A change to the tenant's settings, under field-mask semantics: IReadOnlyList<string> TenantSettingsPatch.Fields lists
what the request sets, and nothing else is touched.

TenantState.description:
The lifecycle state of a tenant, which decides whether a request or background work may
run against it.

channel.description: The key of a registered notification channel, such as `email`.

TestNotificationRequest.description:
Names the channel a user sends themselves a test message through: the body of the caller's
own test notification. The inbox cannot be tested; every other registered channel can.

TestNotificationResult.description: What a channel's test send to the caller came to.

ownerId.description: The new owner: an active individual member. Their own user grant, if any, is removed.

kind.description:
What the row stands for; write-once, UserKind.Individual or
UserKind.Service at creation. UserKind.System is row 1's
alone.

subject.description:
The identity server's subject of a person, or a service account's client id; server-owned,
`varchar(255)` compared byte for byte, unique when present. Null until the user is
invited or issued credentials, and always null for the system user.

email.description:
The sign-in email address, `nvarchar(255)`, trimmed and lower-cased; the natural key.
Required for an individual and refused for any other kind; editable only while the user
is UserState.New.

state.description:
How far the user has come; computed and stored by the database from
DateTimeOffset? User.InvitedAt and DateTimeOffset? User.JoinedAt, and never written by the application.

invitedAt.description: When the user was last invited, `datetimeoffset(3)`; server-owned.

oneOf.description: The identity server's answer to the last successful invitation; server-owned.

lastInviteError.description:
The identity server's error for the last failed invitation of the user, verbatim,
`nvarchar(1024)`; server-owned, and cleared by a successful one.

joinedAt.description:
When an individual first signed in to the tenant, or a service account was first issued
credentials, `datetimeoffset(3)`; server-owned, the join evidence.

name.description: The name in the tenant's primary language, `nvarchar(255)`.

name2.description: The name in the tenant's secondary language.

name3.description: The name in the tenant's tertiary language.

imageId.description: The user's picture, a blob any member may read.

signatureId.description:
The user's handwritten signature, a transparent image of at most 1 MiB that any member
may read, so it can be shown over an approval on any document the member can read.

preferredLanguage.description: A bare language code, such as `ar`, `varchar(35)`; null for the tenant's primary language.

preferredCalendar.description: A calendar code, such as `gc`, `varchar(16)`; null for the tenant's primary calendar.

preferredTimeZone.description: A current IANA time zone id, `varchar(64)`; null for the tenant's time zone.

preferredRegion.description:
An upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region, such as `AE`, `varchar(2)`, which picks
the user's formats; null for the tenant's region.

oneOf.description: The digits the user reads numbers and dates in; null for the tenant's.
The grammatical gender the user is addressed in; null for neutral forms.

contactEmail.description: The address the platform writes to, `nvarchar(255)`; null for string? User.Email.

contactMobile.description: A mobile number in E.164 form, `varchar(32)`.

isActive.description:
Whether the user may use the tenant; server-owned. Every user is created active, and the
activate and deactivate actions alone change it.

roleMemberships.description:
The user's role memberships, saved with the user: null leaves them untouched, an empty list
deletes them all, and a list replaces them.

createdAt.description: When the row was created; server-owned, `datetimeoffset(7)`.

createdById.description: The user who created the row; server-owned, a foreign key to `core.Users`.

modifiedAt.description:
When the row was last changed by a user-visible mutation; server-owned,
`datetimeoffset(7)`, and the row's concurrency token.

modifiedById.description: The user who last changed the row; server-owned, a foreign key to `core.Users`.

id.description:
The primary key. Server-owned: the allocator assigns it to a new row, and a client value
on an existing row only addresses that row.

User.description:
A member of the tenant: a person, a service account, or the tenant's own system user (row 1).
Every top-level row's audit columns reference it. The platform's default: a distribution
extends it by inheritance and registers its class as the leaf.

userId.description: The grantee: an active individual member other than the row's owner.

access.description: What the grant lets the grantee do.

UserGrant.description: A user grant the `share` action adds, or whose access it changes.

UserKind.description:
What a user row stands for. Stored as the member's name, `varchar(10)`, and fixed when
the row is created.

UserPreferenceKeysArguments.description:
The keys a delete removes from a preference bag: the body of the caller's own delete, and
the arguments of an administrator's delete from another user's bag. A key the bag does not
hold is no error.

UserPreferencesArguments.description:
The preferences a set writes into a preference bag: the body of the caller's own set, and
the arguments of an administrator's set of another user's bag. Keys the items do not name
are kept.

UserPreferencesRequest.description: Names the user whose preferences an administrator reads.

preferences.description: Every key the bag holds, with its value.

UserPreferencesResult.description: Another user's preference bag, as an administrator reads or writes it.

id.description: The caller's user id.

kind.description: Whether the caller is an individual or a service account.

state.description: How far the caller's invitation got.

name.description: The name in the tenant's first content language.

name2.description: The name in the second content language; null for none.

name3.description: The name in the third content language; null for none.

email.description: The sign-in email; null for a service account.

contactEmail.description: The address notifications go to instead of the sign-in email; null for the sign-in email.

contactMobile.description: The mobile number, in international format; null for none.

imageId.description: The profile picture's blob; null for none.

signatureId.description: The signature's blob; null for none.

preferredLanguage.description: The preferred language; null for the tenant's default.

preferredCalendar.description: The preferred calendar; null for the tenant's default.

preferredTimeZone.description: The preferred time zone; null for the tenant's default.

preferredRegion.description: The preferred region; null for the language's default.

oneOf.description: The preferred digits; null for the language's default.
The gender; null when not stated.

modifiedAt.description: The row's stamp, which the caller's next profile edit echoes.

UserProfileView.description: The caller's own profile, as the `me` envelope carries it.

UserState.description:
How far a user has come, as the tenant's own evidence shows it. The database computes it from
the user's invitation and join timestamps and stores it as the member's name,
`varchar(8)`; the application never writes it.
